front: Meticulously look for hidden doors, hazards, and the like while exploring at reduced speed.
back:
Move at half Speed with an educated guess of where to look. To be thorough and guarantee checking everything, travel at no more than 300 feet per minute (150 to check before walking into it). Can move slower for more thoroughness.
If you come across a secret door, item, or hazard, the GM makes a free secret Seek check for you.
Many objects to search takes much longer.
